what: Circuit-mapped ship-vs-background detection (screening figure of merit), ngspice circuit vs closed-form reservoir, 15 seeds, recording-level
verdict: Re-mapped through the circuit, the ship-vs-background detector keeps its operating characteristic: ROC-AUC 0.81 (closed-form 0.813; companion device 0.793), Pd 0.295/0.509 at Pfa 0.05/0.10; circuit-minus-closed AUC -0.002 (95% CI [-0.005,0.000]). The screening role is circuit-validated, not only the multi-class accuracy.
